meanings.note: Pinyin: yí gòng. Sums up items or prices before the verb or number (一共十二块 'twelve yuan in total').

examples.text: 在这儿！一共三十八块，找回十二块零钱。
examples.trans: Right here! Thirty-eight yuan in total, with twelve yuan back in change.

examples.text: 四杯红茶一共二十八块钱。
examples.trans: Four cups of black tea come to twenty-eight yuan in total.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yí yàng. Pairs with 跟/和 in 跟…一样 ('the same as…').

examples.text: 等等，深蓝色的，跟您的一样啊！
examples.trans: Wait—it is dark blue, the same as yours!

examples.text: 哎呀！我跑得太急，包装看着都一样！
examples.trans: Oh no! I was running in such a rush that the wrappers all looked alike!

meanings.note: Pinyin: yì zhí. Describes walking straight (一直走) or doing something non-stop.

examples.text: 出大门往左拐，一直走到石桥。
examples.trans: Go out the front gate, turn left, and walk straight to the stone bridge.

examples.text: 志豪先生！您一直站在后面吗？！
examples.trans: Mr Zhihao! Were you standing right there behind us?!

meanings.note: Pinyin: shàng. Used both as a directional verb/complement ('up, onto') and location word ('on top of').

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

examples.text: 就在您额头上，安全得很。
examples.trans: Right there on your forehead, completely safe.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shàng fāng. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 正上方 ('the space right above').

examples.text: 门上方只画着一把金色钥匙。拿旧阀门给店员看。
examples.trans: Only a golden key painted above the door. Show the clerk the old valve.

examples.text: 书桌上方挂着一盏暖黄色的灯。
examples.trans: A warm yellow lamp hangs directly above the desk.

related.gloss: the space right above (measure word 个)

meanings.note: Pinyin: xià wǔ. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个下午 ('an afternoon').

examples.text: 您尽管看，宋老师。星期一下午大堂暗。
examples.trans: Go right ahead, Teacher Song. Monday afternoon the lobby was dim.

examples.text: 先别对外面透露一个字！让两兄弟先过完这个星期五下午！
examples.trans: Not a single word to anyone outside yet! Let the two brothers have their Friday afternoon first!

meanings.note: Pinyin: xià lái. Compound directional complement for downward motion or writing something down to keep.

examples.text: 快问他叫什么名字！记下来！
examples.trans: Quick, ask him what his name is! Write it down!

examples.text: 请一定写下来！三楼热水：满分十分！
examples.trans: Please be sure to write that down! Third-floor hot water: ten out of ten!

meanings.note: Friendly farewell xiàcì jiàn.

examples.text: 今天聊得很开心，下次见！
examples.trans: Great chatting today, see you next time!

examples.text: 我们下次见！
examples.trans: See you next time!

meanings.note: Pinyin: xià mian. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 最下面 ('the bottom part').

examples.text: 快拿到楼下灯光下面看看吧！
examples.trans: Let's bring it downstairs under the light and take a look!

examples.text: 志豪先生早！在木房梁下面睡得好吗？
examples.trans: Morning, Mr Zhihao! Did you sleep well beneath the wooden beams?

examples.text: 你甭纠结，他基本上不会记得你是谁。
examples.trans: Do not agonise over it — he basically will not remember who you are.

examples.text: 你甭纠结，他基本上不会记得你是谁。
examples.trans: Do not agonise over it — he basically will not remember who you are.

meanings.note: Pinyin: liǎng. Used instead of 二 when counting things with a measure word (两个, 两把, 两间).

examples.text: 那是什么铃声？有人按了两下！
examples.trans: What was that bell sound? Somebody rang twice!

examples.text: 就算四号房空着，旧电线也会响两下。
examples.trans: Even when room four is empty, the old wire still rings twice.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gè. Most common Mandarin measure word (量词), placed between a number/demonstrative and a noun (一个人, 这个).

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 刚烤好的面包卷！趁热拿一个吧。
examples.trans: Freshly baked bread rolls! Take one while it is hot.

meanings.note: Pinyin: le. After a verb, marks completion; at the end of a sentence, signals a change of situation.

examples.text: 早上好！请问，门锁了吗？
examples.trans: Good morning! Excuse me, is the door locked?

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

meanings.note: Pinyin: èr shí sì. Cardinal number twenty-four ('two tens four'); followed by a measure word before nouns.

examples.text: 一天有二十四个小时。
examples.trans: There are twenty-four hours in a day.

examples.text: 两打茶杯一共是二十四个。
examples.trans: Two dozen teacups come to twenty-four in total.

meanings.note: Pinyin: liàng. Describes bright light or a surface polished clean (擦亮 'polish bright').

examples.text: 隔壁的小洗手间呢？灯亮吗？
examples.trans: What about the small bathroom next door? Does the light work?

examples.text: 火苗亮了——稳稳的蓝火，正合适。
examples.trans: The flame is lit—steady blue fire, right as it should be.

meanings.note: Pinyin: cóng. Marks a starting point in space or time (从早上到晚上 'from morning to night').

examples.text: 给您四号钥匙。早餐从七点半到十点。
examples.trans: Here is key number four for you. Breakfast is from seven thirty to ten.

examples.text: 从这儿往里走。我帮您把蓝色行李箱提上去。
examples.trans: Walk inward from here. I will carry the blue suitcase up for you.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhù. Means 'reside/stay overnight' as a main verb, or 'firmly in place' as a result complement (记住, 拿住).

examples.text: 今天四号房的客人住一整个星期，一定要完美！
examples.trans: Today's guest in room four is staying a whole week; everything must be perfect!

examples.text: 没有啊，周经理，南方来的夫妻一小时前住进六号房了。
examples.trans: No, Manager Zhou, the couple from the south checked into room six an hour ago.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nǐ. Everyday singular 'you' among colleagues, friends, and peers; use 您 for polite respect.

examples.text: 我叫老陈。你早到了十分钟。
examples.trans: I'm called Chen. You arrived ten minutes early.

examples.text: 你好！你就是小晴吧？我是厨房的小美。
examples.trans: Hello! You must be Qing, right? I am Mei from the kitchen.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nǐ men. Plural 'you' for addressing two or more people (including polite groups).

examples.text: 太谢谢你们两位了。
examples.trans: Thank you both so very much.

examples.text: 不怪你们。只是我身上只有这件外套！
examples.trans: It is not your fault. Still, I only have this one coat on me!

meanings.note: Pinyin: liǎ. Colloquial fusion of 两个, never followed by 个 (我们俩 'the two of us').

examples.text: 啊！黄色柠檬糖霜——每个星期五我们俩都抢边角那一块！
examples.trans: Oh! Yellow lemon glaze—every single Friday the two of us fought over the corner piece!

examples.text: 别动，你们俩。听到路边汽车停下的声音了吗？
examples.trans: Hold still, both of you. Hear that car engine stopping at the curb?

meanings.note: Pinyin: tíng. Used for vehicles pulling up, rain stopping, or pausing an action.

examples.text: 别动，你们俩。听到路边汽车停下的声音了吗？
examples.trans: Hold still, both of you. Hear that car engine stopping at the curb?

examples.text: 一辆黄色出租车刚停在铁大门外头！
examples.trans: A yellow taxi just pulled up outside the iron gate!

meanings.note: Pinyin: pinyin. This is a part used in conversational Mandarin.

examples.text: 我有一个儿。
examples.trans: I have a 儿.

examples.text: 这是一个非常好的儿。
examples.trans: This is a very good 儿.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiān. Placed before the verb to sequence actions: 先…再… ('first…, then…').

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

examples.text: 第一条规矩：先喝热茶，再去开门。
examples.trans: Rule number one: drink hot tea first, then go answer the door.

meanings.note: Pinyin: liù. Cardinal number 6.

examples.text: 老陈……小晴……快告诉我今晚六号房空着。
examples.trans: Chen... Qing... please tell me room six is free tonight.

examples.text: 没有啊，周经理，南方来的夫妻一小时前住进六号房了。
examples.trans: No, Manager Zhou, the couple from the south checked into room six an hour ago.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zài. Marks a next step in sequence (先提再推) or a future repetition (再见 'see you again').

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

examples.text: 第一条规矩：先喝热茶，再去开门。
examples.trans: Rule number one: drink hot tea first, then go answer the door.

meanings.note: Pinyin: liáng. Describes pleasantly cool air or hot water/food that has cooled down (放凉).

examples.text: 谢谢你，小美。刚才吓了一跳，手都凉了！
examples.trans: Thank you, Mei. That gave me such a start just now that my hands went cold!

examples.text: 摸摸热水管——下面是温的，上面变凉了。
examples.trans: Feel the hot-water pipe—the bottom is warm, while the top is turning cool.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jǐ. Asks about small numbers (几点 'what time', 几个 'how many') before a measure word.

examples.text: 真的？您不介意多爬几步楼梯？
examples.trans: Really? You do not mind climbing a few extra stairs?

examples.text: 那家五金店早上几点开门？
examples.trans: What time does that hardware shop open in the morning?

meanings.note: Pinyin: gāng cái. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 刚才那一刻 ('that moment just now').

examples.text: 谢谢你，小美。刚才吓了一跳，手都凉了！
examples.trans: Thank you, Mei. That gave me such a start just now that my hands went cold!

examples.text: 您刚才忘在楼下前台汤碗旁边了。
examples.trans: You left it downstairs beside the soup bowl at the front desk.

related.gloss: that moment just now (measure word 个)

meanings.note: Pinyin: dào. Works as main verb ('arrive') or result complement ('succeed in reaching/perceiving', 找到, 听到).

examples.text: 我叫老陈。你早到了十分钟。
examples.trans: I'm called Chen. You arrived ten minutes early.

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房的客人今天到。
examples.trans: Yes, eight rooms, eight brass keys. Room four's guest arrives today.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shí. Cardinal number 10; building block for 11–99.

examples.text: 我叫老陈。你早到了十分钟。
examples.trans: I'm called Chen. You arrived ten minutes early.

examples.text: 给您四号钥匙。早餐从七点半到十点。
examples.trans: Here is key number four for you. Breakfast is from seven thirty to ten.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shí èr. Cardinal number 十 ('ten') + 二 ('two').

examples.text: 阳光房里一共可以摆十二把木椅。
examples.trans: Twelve wooden chairs in all can be arranged in the sunroom.

examples.text: 一年有十二个月。
examples.trans: There are twelve months in a year.

压.gloss: press down; weigh down; pin underneath

meanings.en: press down; weigh down; pin underneath
meanings.note: Pinyin: yā. Action verb for pressing from above or holding flat under an object (压着 'pinned/resting underneath').

examples.text: 快看铁盒子最底下的薄纸下面，还压着一个小方信封！
examples.trans: Look underneath the tissue paper at the very bottom of the tin box—a tiny square envelope is tucked underneath!

examples.text: 老陈拿了一块光滑的鹅卵石，把桌上的图纸压稳。
examples.trans: Chen took a smooth river pebble to weight the drawing paper down steadily on the table.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lí mǐ. Metric unit classifier 厘 ('one-hundredth') + 米 ('metre'); takes numerals directly without 个 (两厘米 'two centimetres').

examples.text: 把院子上面的气窗推开两厘米，让走廊的空气流动起来。
examples.trans: Push the courtyard transom window open two centimetres so the air in the hallway circulates.

examples.text: 左边这扇窗板再往上抬半厘米就正好对齐了。
examples.trans: Lift this left shutter half a centimetre higher and it will line up squarely.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chú fáng. Measure word (量词): 间 (jiān), e.g. 一间厨房 ('a kitchen').

examples.text: 你好！你就是小晴吧？我是厨房的小美。
examples.trans: Hello! You must be Qing, right? I am Mei from the kitchen.

examples.text: 糟了！周经理，小晴，厨房出急事了！
examples.trans: Oh no! Manager Zhou, Qing, we have a kitchen emergency!

meanings.note: Pinyin: qù. Movement away from the speaker, as main verb (去车站) or directional complement (上去).

examples.text: 第一条规矩：先喝热茶，再去开门。
examples.trans: Rule number one: drink hot tea first, then go answer the door.

examples.text: 晚上九点？等等，我们一起去开大门。
examples.trans: At nine o'clock? Wait, let us open the gate together.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shuāng. Counts naturally paired items: shoes, socks, chopsticks, hands (一双皮鞋 'a pair of leather shoes').

examples.text: 两双棕色大男鞋，还有灰色毛衣。
examples.trans: Two pairs of big brown men's shoes, plus grey sweaters.

examples.text: 天哪……看这双眼睛！第三级台阶上的小志豪？！
examples.trans: Good heavens... look at those eyes! Little Zhihao from the third step?!

meanings.note: Pinyin: yòu. Pairs with 往 or 边: 往右 ('to the right'), 右边 ('the right side'); opposite of 左.

examples.text: 往右用力转一下……开了！
examples.trans: One firm turn to the right... and it's open!

examples.text: 过了桥往右走。
examples.trans: After the bridge, go right.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yè zi. Measure word (量词): 片 (piàn), e.g. 一片叶子 ('a leaf'). Formed from 叶 ('leaf') + nominal suffix 子.

examples.text: 那本绿布面旧书里夹着好几片干薄荷叶子。
examples.trans: Pressed inside that old green cloth-bound book are several dry mint leaves.

examples.text: 秋风一吹，院子里梧桐树的黄叶子慢慢飘下来。
examples.trans: When the autumn breeze blows, yellow leaves from the courtyard wutong tree drift slowly down.

meanings.note: Pinyin: ma. Placed at the end of any statement to turn it into a neutral yes/no question.

examples.text: 早上好！请问，门锁了吗？
examples.trans: Good morning! Excuse me, is the door locked?

examples.text: 纸本子？真的吗？
examples.trans: A paper notebook? Really?

meanings.note: Pinyin: chuī. Used for wind blowing or blowing on hot tea.

examples.text: 热汤？在冷雨中走过来之后，这听起来太棒了。
examples.trans: Hot soup? After that cold walk in the rain, that sounds wonderful.

examples.text: 晚上院子里吹着凉风。
examples.trans: A cool breeze blows through the courtyard in the evening.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gào su. Takes a person directly followed by the information (告诉我 'tell me').

examples.text: 太好了。请告诉我需要知道什么。
examples.trans: Great. Please tell me what I need to know.

examples.text: 告诉他们，我箱子上面口袋里有红丝带！
examples.trans: Tell them there is a red ribbon inside the top pocket of my case!

meanings.note: Pinyin: ne. After a noun, asks 'what about X?' (你呢？); at the end of a statement, highlights an ongoing situation.

examples.text: 等一下，咖啡厅的小美正朝我招手呢！
examples.trans: Wait a moment—Mei in the café is waving toward me right now!

examples.text: 来成都的第一个晚上，怎么能难过呢！
examples.trans: On your very first evening in Chengdu, how could you sit around sad!

meanings.note: Pinyin: hé. Joins nouns or pronouns ('A and B'), NEVER two whole clauses; also means 'with' (和你一样).

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 因为好咖啡和热面包让人开心呀！
examples.trans: Because good coffee and warm bread make people happy!

meanings.note: Colloquial pronoun zánliǎ ('you and I, the two of us').

examples.text: 咱俩都分手两年了。
examples.trans: The two of us broke up two years ago.

examples.text: 咱俩一起去喝杯茶吧。
examples.trans: Let the two of us go get a cup of tea.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiǎng. Used for bells, phones, pipes, or alarms ringing or clanking.

examples.text: 就算四号房空着，旧电线也会响两下。
examples.trans: Even when room four is empty, the old wire still rings twice.

examples.text: 谁也别说出去！门铃响的时候要微笑。
examples.trans: Do not tell anyone! Smile warmly when the bell rings.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nǎ. Combines with a measure word to ask 'which?' (哪个 'which one?', 哪间 'which room?').

examples.text: 等一下，小晴……你拿了哪一包黄油？
examples.trans: Wait a second, Qing... which packet of butter did you grab?

examples.text: 对！左边有两条小路——我走哪一条？
examples.trans: Yes! There are two small lanes on the left—which one do I take?

meanings.note: Pinyin: yuán. Describes round tables, seals, or shapes.

examples.text: 这面圆镜子挂哪儿？窗户左边还是右边？
examples.trans: Where should I hang this round mirror? Left of the window or right?

examples.text: 院子中间有一张圆木桌。
examples.trans: There is a round wooden table in the middle of the courtyard.

meanings.note: Pinyin: quān. Counts full turns of a key, wrench, or lap around a block (一圈 'one full turn').

examples.text: 一圈，两圈……看新铜螺纹咬合得多干净。
examples.trans: One turn, two turns... look how cleanly the new brass thread fits.

examples.text: 我绕着广场走了一圈。
examples.trans: I walked one lap around the square.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zài. As main verb/preposition, gives location (在院子里); before another verb, marks ongoing action ('be doing').

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dà. Everyday adjective for size, age, and strong wind or rain.

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 两双棕色大男鞋，还有灰色毛衣。
examples.trans: Two pairs of big brown men's shoes, plus grey sweaters.

meanings.note: Prefix/noun tóu ('first, initial; head').

examples.text: 开篇的头一句就是道可道。
examples.trans: The very first line at the opening is Dao Ke Dao.

examples.text: 这是我头一回进大型演播室。
examples.trans: This is my very first time inside a major TV studio.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiā. First-tone jiā: hold something pinched between two surfaces, such as under one's arm (夹在胳膊底下) or inside book pages.

examples.text: 周经理把绿色登记本夹在胳膊底下走来走去。
examples.trans: Manager Zhou paced back and forth with the green guest book tucked under his arm.

examples.text: 她在旧书里夹了一片干树叶做书签。
examples.trans: She tucked a dried leaf inside the old book as a bookmark.

meanings.en: set; suite; series (classifier for coordinated items, plans, clothes, or housing)
meanings.note: Pinyin: tào. Very common measure word for matching collections, systems, apartments, or complete proposals (e.g., 一套方案, 一套房子).
As a noun, figuratively refers to a scheme or trap (下套 'to lay a trap', 钻套 'to walk into a trap'), and literally to an outer cover (手套 'gloves', 外套 'coat').

examples.text: 又不是只有一套方案。
examples.trans: It is not as if we only have one set of plans.

examples.text: 你还看不出来吗？这就是个套！
examples.trans: Can't you see it yet? This whole thing is a setup!

meanings.en: fragile or fussy (of delicate objects or pampered habits)
meanings.note: Pinyin: jiāo qì. Playfully personifies thin paper globes, fresh berries, or fine china as needing gentle handling.

examples.text: 那些娇气的纸灯球，要不要先试试下午的风再撑开？
examples.trans: Should we test the afternoon wind first before unfolding those delicate paper globes?

examples.text: 刚摘下的夏莓最娇气，只能用软亚麻布轻轻蘸干水珠。
examples.trans: Freshly picked summer berries are super delicate, so you can only dab them dry gently with soft linen.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiáo měi. Friendly name of Courtyard Inn's baker and barista.

examples.text: 你好！你就是小晴吧？我是厨房的小美。
examples.trans: Hello! You must be Qing, right? I am Mei from the kitchen.

examples.text: 你好，小美，很高兴认识你！好香啊！
examples.trans: Hello, Mei, nice to meet you! Something smells wonderful!

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiù. Highlights immediacy, exact location (就在这里), or smooth consequence ('then').

examples.text: 就在您额头上，安全得很。
examples.trans: Right there on your forehead, completely safe.

examples.text: 朝院子，就在老树上面，非常安静。
examples.trans: Toward the courtyard, right above the old tree; it is very quiet.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiù xiàng. Introduces a vivid comparison.

examples.text: 每天服务街坊邻居——就像对公众开放的早间咖啡馆？！
examples.trans: Serves neighbours daily—like a morning café open to the public?!

examples.text: 住在这里就像回到自己家一样舒服。
examples.trans: Staying here feels just as cozy as coming home.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zuǒ. Measure word (量词): 边 (biān), e.g. 左边 ('the left side').

examples.text: 上楼梯，平台往左拐，最上面最后一扇门。
examples.trans: Up the stairs, turn left at the landing, last door at the very top.

examples.text: 出大门往左拐，一直走到石桥。
examples.trans: Go out the front gate, turn left, and walk straight to the stone bridge.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zuǒ bian. Measure word (量词): 边 (biān), e.g. 左边 ('the left side').

examples.text: 这面圆镜子挂哪儿？窗户左边还是右边？
examples.trans: Where should I hang this round mirror? Left of the window or right?

examples.text: 对！左边有两条小路——我走哪一条？
examples.trans: Yes! There are two small lanes on the left—which one do I take?

meanings.note: Pinyin: yǐ jīng. Often pairs with sentence-final 了 (已经到了 'has already arrived').

examples.text: 没错！你已经很习惯这儿了。
examples.trans: Exactly! You already fit right in here.

examples.text: 还好烤箱里的面团已经放进去了。
examples.trans: My dough is already in the oven, at least.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kāi. Versatile verb for opening doors, starting business, turning on taps/lights, or water boiling.

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 当然不能偷看……咦，自己翻开在中间那页了！
examples.trans: Of course we must not peek... oh, it fell open to the middle page by itself!

meanings.en: graceful arc; curved trajectory or suspended drape
meanings.note: Pinyin: hú xiàn. Measure word (量词): 道 (dào) or 条 (tiáo). Joins 弧 (arc) with 线 (line).

examples.text: 你们俩就停在那儿！从厨房门口看过去，那道弧线美极了！
examples.trans: Hold it right there, both of you! From the kitchen door, that curve looks magical!

examples.text: 二十四盏灯笼在阳台上空拉出四道暖金色的弧线。
examples.trans: Twenty-four lanterns traced four warm golden arcs high above the balcony.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wān. Used as a stative/resultative complement (掰弯 'bend out of shape') or verb (转弯 'turn a corner').

examples.text: 我们生怕用力太猛，把彩绘铁盒盖子掰弯了。
examples.trans: We were afraid of using too much force and bending the painted tin lid.

examples.text: 窄窄的石头小巷往南拐了一个弯。
examples.trans: The narrow cobbled lane curved around to the south.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wǎng wài. Directional phrase 往 ('toward') + 外 ('outside').

examples.text: 透过擦干净的拱窗往外看，整个院子绿油油的。
examples.trans: Looking outward through the clean arched window, the whole courtyard is lush green.

examples.text: 这两扇木头窗板是往外推开的。
examples.trans: These two wooden shutters swing open outward.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kuài. As an adjective/adverb, 'fast/quickly'; in 快…了, 'about to'.

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 小晴，快看里面！这不是我的箱子！
examples.trans: Qing, look inside quickly! This is not my case!

examples.text: 实习感觉怎么样？
examples.trans: How does the internship feel?

examples.text: 推开木门走进院子，给人一种回到老家的温暖感觉。
examples.trans: Pushing open the wooden gate and stepping into the courtyard gives you the warm feeling of coming home.

meanings.note: Colloquial phrase màndiǎn ('go easy, watch your step').

examples.text: 大家慢点啊，注意脚下安全！
examples.trans: Take it easy everyone, watch your step!

examples.text: 雨天路滑，开车慢点。
examples.trans: Roads are slick in the rain, so drive slowly.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wǒ. First-person singular pronoun; add 的 for 'my' (我的) and 们 for 'we/us' (我们).

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 我叫老陈。你早到了十分钟。
examples.trans: I'm called Chen. You arrived ten minutes early.

meanings.note: Pinyin: cái. Signals that something happened later than expected or in a small amount—contrast 就.

examples.text: 老砖房顶楼平时要等很久水才热。
examples.trans: Top floors in old brick houses usually wait ages before the water warms up.

examples.text: 因为房子只是砖头和木头，志鹏，家人才是留住的东西。
examples.trans: Because a house is only brick and timber, Zhipeng—family is what we keep.

meanings.note: Modal phrase cáinéng ('only then be able to').

examples.text: 经历很多困难，才能成为核心人物。
examples.trans: Only after enduring many trials can one become a leader.

examples.text: 认真准备才能把节目做好。
examples.trans: Only careful preparation makes a good show.

meanings.en: hit; make (a call); give (a score); fetch
meanings.note: Pinyin: dǎ. Light verb forming dozens of everyday expressions (打电话 'make a phone call').

examples.text: 小晴，马上给火车站失物处打电话。
examples.trans: Qing, call the train station lost-and-found office right away.

examples.text: 我正在打……您好，请问有人找蓝色行李箱吗？
examples.trans: I am calling now... Hello, excuse me, is anyone looking for a blue suitcase?

meanings.en: measure word for handled objects; disposal marker
meanings.note: Pinyin: bǎ. Counts items with handles or backs (一把钥匙, 一把椅子); as a preposition, fronts a definite object before an action verb.

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房的客人今天到。
examples.trans: Yes, eight rooms, eight brass keys. Room four's guest arrives today.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tái. Means raising upward or two people lifting an object together.

examples.text: 我们俩一起把这扇长窗板抬进走廊吧。
examples.trans: Let's lift this tall shutter together and carry it into the hallway.

examples.text: 按下琴键时，里面的小琴槌就会稳稳抬起来。
examples.trans: When you press the piano key, the small hammer inside rises smoothly.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lā. Opposite of 推 ('push'); used for pulling doors, shutters, or suitcase handles.

examples.text: 电线本来就该拉直了。正常保养，别多想。
examples.trans: The wire needed straightening anyway. Routine maintenance—don't read into it.

examples.text: 让我把眼镜从额头上拉下来……九号房？！
examples.trans: Let me pull my glasses down from my forehead... Room Nine?!

meanings.note: Pinyin: gǒng mén. Compound 拱 ('arch') + 门 ('door/gate'). Measure word: 道 (dào) or 扇 (shàn).

examples.text: 志豪在速写本上画下了院子的石头拱门。
examples.trans: Hao sketched the courtyard's stone archway in his sketchbook.

examples.text: 穿过这道砖拱门，就能看见后面的小花园。
examples.trans: Walk through this brick archway and you can see the little garden behind.

meanings.note: Pinyin: guà. Used for hanging keys, coats, lanterns, or hanging up a phone.

examples.text: 这面圆镜子挂哪儿？窗户左边还是右边？
examples.trans: Where should I hang this round mirror? Left of the window or right?

examples.text: 挂在书桌右边吧，那里光线好。
examples.trans: Hang it to the right of the desk, where the light is good.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiē. Used for answering calls (接电话), meeting someone at a station, or catching drips.

examples.text: 完了！昨天我没戴眼镜，在平板上接了电话预订！
examples.trans: Disaster! Yesterday without my glasses I took a phone booking on the tablet!

examples.text: 志豪接干毛巾的时候随手放下的！
examples.trans: Hao set it down casually when he took the dry towel!

meanings.en: to stretch open (an umbrella, paper lantern, or tent)
meanings.note: Pinyin: chēng kāi. Pairs 撑 (prop outward) with 开 (open) for items that hold their shape once expanded.

examples.text: 那些娇气的纸灯球，要不要先试试下午的风再撑开？
examples.trans: Should we test the afternoon wind first before unfolding those delicate paper globes?

examples.text: 来不及了——周经理已经把第一条绳上的十二盏都撑开了，正大步往外走呢！
examples.trans: Too late—Zhou already opened twelve lanterns on line one, and he's marching right out!

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiāo. Read first tone jiāo when teaching a skill or person (教钢琴 'teach piano').

examples.text: 二十五年前我在附近教钢琴，不过记忆淡了。
examples.trans: Twenty-five years ago I taught piano nearby, though memories fade.

examples.text: 何止认识！整整六年，每个星期五我都爬那座木楼梯教钢琴！
examples.trans: More than know it! Every Friday for six whole years I climbed those wooden stairs to teach piano!

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhěng gè. Combines 整 ('whole') + 个; modifies singular nouns directly without another measure word (整个中央八度).

examples.text: 修好那根琴槌以后，宋老师给整个中央八度调了音。
examples.trans: After fixing that hammer, Teacher Song tuned the entire middle octave.

examples.text: 柠檬挞的香味飘满了整个咖啡角。
examples.trans: The aroma of lemon tart drifted through the entire café corner.

meanings.note: Pinyin: míng wǎn. Compact spoken contraction of 明天晚上 (míng tiān wǎn shang).

examples.text: 稳稳接住了！快告诉我打哪种结，才能一直绷紧到明晚？
examples.trans: Caught cleanly! Tell me what kind of knot keeps this cord tight until tomorrow evening!

examples.text: 一点儿纸都没破！不过明晚要是再刮风，这两条绳还是会碰在一起。
examples.trans: Not a speck of torn paper! Still, if the wind blows tomorrow evening, these two lines will touch again.

meanings.en: rosy and golden clouds illuminated by the setting sun
meanings.note: Pinyin: wǎn xiá. Measure word (量词): 片 (piàn) or 抹 (mǒ). Contrasts with 朝霞 (dawn glow).

examples.text: 暖金色和浅珊瑚色错开挂，整个石板院子就像晚霞一样！
examples.trans: Alternate warm gold and soft coral so the whole stone courtyard feels like sunset!

examples.text: 傍晚茶会开场时，天边的晚霞和二楼灯笼互相映衬。
examples.trans: As the evening tea began, the sunset glow on the horizon answered the warm glow of the balcony lanterns.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nuǎn. Describes cozy warmth of tea, sunlight, or clothing.

examples.text: 每次弹完琴，他都问为什么下雨天钢琴声音更暖。
examples.trans: Whenever I finished playing, he asked why the piano sounded warmer on rainy days.

examples.text: 喝碗热汤，身子一下子就暖了。
examples.trans: Drink a bowl of hot soup and you warm right up.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yuè. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个月 ('a month').

examples.text: 这是我这个月睡得最香的一晚，洗澡水也热极了！
examples.trans: Best sleep I have had all month, and the shower water was wonderfully hot!

examples.text: 志豪先生，看第一页：下个月改建商业办公室。我们完了！
examples.trans: Mr Zhihao, look at page one: commercial office conversion next month. We are finished!

meanings.note: Pinyin: yǒu. Expresses both possession ('I have') and existence ('there is'); ALWAYS negated with 没 (没有), never 不.

examples.text: 有道理！这些是钥匙吗？
examples.trans: Fair enough! Are these the keys?

examples.text: 那是什么铃声？有人按了两下！
examples.trans: What was that bell sound? Somebody rang twice!

条.gloss: measure word for streets, rivers, towels, clauses

meanings.en: measure word for streets, rivers, towels, clauses
meanings.note: Pinyin: tiáo. Counts long, narrow, or winding things: streets, rivers, scarves, towels, trousers, and legal clauses (一条街).

examples.text: 第一条规矩：先喝热茶，再去开门。
examples.trans: Rule number one: drink hot tea first, then go answer the door.

examples.text: 小美跟这条街上所有人说话都像老朋友。
examples.trans: Mei talks to everyone on this street like old friends.

meanings.en: not have enough time; be too late
meanings.note: Pinyin: lái bu jí. Opposite of 来得及 ('make it in time').

examples.text: 来不及了！他说了声谢谢就挂断了！
examples.trans: Too late! He said thank you and hung up!

examples.text: 再不出发就来不及赶八点的火车了！
examples.trans: If we do not head out now, we will never make the eight o'clock train!

meanings.note: Pinyin: jí le. Follows directly after an adjective to boost it to the max (棒极了！ 'amazing!', 热极了 'super hot!').

examples.text: 等等，咸黄油配果酱不行，做炒蛋却棒极了！
examples.trans: Wait—salted butter fails with jam, yet for scrambled eggs it is amazing!

examples.text: 这是我这个月睡得最香的一晚，洗澡水也热极了！
examples.trans: Best sleep I have had all month, and the shower water was wonderfully hot!

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhī. Classifier for slender plant stems, flower sprays, or herb sprigs (两小枝香草 'two small sprigs of herbs', 一枝玫瑰 'a rose stem').

examples.text: 小美让志鹏用细棉绳绑好两小枝刚摘下来的新鲜香草。
examples.trans: Mei had Peng tie two small sprigs of freshly picked herbs together with fine cotton string.

examples.text: 小晴在玻璃花瓶里插了一枝嫩绿的枝叶，桌子一下子亮了起来。
examples.trans: Qing placed a sprig of fresh green foliage in the glass vase, brightening the table right up.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shù. Measure word (量词): 棵, e.g. 一棵树 ('a tree').

examples.text: 朝院子，就在老树上面，非常安静。
examples.trans: Toward the courtyard, right above the old tree; it is very quiet.

examples.text: 只有院子里的老树和雨声。
examples.trans: Only the old tree in the courtyard and the sound of rain.

meanings.en: the highest twigs and leafy crown of a tree
meanings.note: Pinyin: shù shāo. Combines 树 (tree) with 梢 (tip of a branch or shoot).

examples.text: 你看树梢的叶子沙沙响，起风了。
examples.trans: Look at the leaves rustling at the top of the tree; the breeze is picking up.

examples.text: 金灯笼挂在阳台与树梢之间，傍晚风一吹就轻轻晃动。
examples.trans: Gold lanterns strung between the balcony and treetop swayed softly whenever the evening breeze rose.

根.gloss: measure word for pipes, wires, sticks

meanings.en: measure word for pipes, wires, sticks
meanings.note: Pinyin: gēn. Counts long, thin rod-like or cord-like objects (一根水管 'a water pipe', 一根电线 'a wire').

examples.text: 先生，到了。小心碰头，这根木房梁比较低。
examples.trans: Here we are, sir. Mind your head—this wooden beam is fairly low.

examples.text: 老木匠换了一根新的铜水管。
examples.trans: The carpenter replaced it with a new copper water pipe.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhuō zi. Measure word (量词): 张 (zhāng), e.g. 一张桌子 ('a table').

examples.text: 周经理早！桌子很干净，钥匙也准备好了。
examples.trans: Morning, Manager Zhou! The desk is clean, and the keys are ready too.

examples.text: 老板，看一下桌子后面的镜子。
examples.trans: Boss, take a look in the mirror behind the desk.

meanings.en: right in the middle of; squarely; right
meanings.note: Pinyin: zhèng. Before a verb, marks an action in progress right now; before 对着, means 'directly/squarely'.

examples.text: 正合我心意。楼梯在哪儿？
examples.trans: Just what I wanted. Where are the stairs?

examples.text: 等一下，咖啡厅的小美正朝我招手呢！
examples.trans: Wait a moment—Mei in the café is waving toward me right now!

meanings.note: Pinyin: bù. Counts footsteps or stages (一步 'one step').

examples.text: 真的？您不介意多爬几步楼梯？
examples.trans: Really? You do not mind climbing a few extra stairs?

examples.text: 茶壶也烫好了！大家从窗边退后一步！
examples.trans: And the teapot is hot! Everybody step back from the window!

meanings.note: Pinyin: měi. Usually followed by a measure word (每个星期 'every week', 每位客人 'every guest').

examples.text: 每个蓝杯子旁边放一张餐巾和一把小勺子。
examples.trans: Beside every blue cup, put one napkin and one small spoon.

examples.text: 老房子每到星期二就松一颗螺丝。坐吧。
examples.trans: Every Tuesday an old house loosens one screw. Sit down.

meanings.en: rustling; whispering softly like leaves or sand
meanings.note: Pinyin: shā shā. Onomatopoeic reduplication often placed before 响 (xiǎng, 'to sound').

examples.text: 你看树梢的叶子沙沙响，起风了。
examples.trans: Look at the leaves rustling at the top of the tree; the breeze is picking up.

examples.text: 微风吹过院子里的老树，绿叶沙沙作响，凉快极了。
examples.trans: A gentle breeze blew through the old courtyard tree, making the green leaves rustle refreshingly.

meanings.en: light or pale in shade; shallow in depth
meanings.note: Pinyin: qiǎn. Opposite of 深 (shēn, 'deep; dark') for both water and color.

examples.text: 暖金色和浅珊瑚色错开挂，整个石板院子就像晚霞一样！
examples.trans: Alternate warm gold and soft coral so the whole stone courtyard feels like sunset!

examples.text: 这盆水很浅，小晴挽起袖子就把飘在水面的纸捞了起来。
examples.trans: The water in this basin is shallow, so Qing rolled up her sleeves and fished out the floating paper.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dēng. Measure word (量词): 盏 (zhǎn), e.g. 一盏灯 ('a lamp').

examples.text: 因为楼梯窄，而且周经理在那儿放了旧灯箱子。
examples.trans: Because the stairs are narrow, and Manager Zhou put old lamp boxes up there.

examples.text: 隔壁的小洗手间呢？灯亮吗？
examples.trans: What about the small bathroom next door? Does the light work?

meanings.note: Pinyin: dēng long. Measure word (量词): 盏 (zhǎn), e.g. 一盏灯笼 ('a lantern').

examples.text: 老陈，你在为中午挂纸灯笼吗？
examples.trans: Chen, are you hanging those paper lanterns for noon?

examples.text: 抬头看夜空下那些金色灯笼——真宁静啊！
examples.trans: Look up at those golden lanterns against the night sky—how peaceful!

meanings.note: Pinyin: yé ye. Measure word (量词): 位 (wèi), e.g. 一位爷爷 ('a grandfather').

examples.text: 三年前爷爷去世以后，我和志鹏因为卖老房子大吵了一架。
examples.trans: Three years ago after Grandfather passed away, Zhipeng and I argued bitterly over selling the old house.

examples.text: 我只写了：星期五中午，爷爷留的东西在小院客栈等你。
examples.trans: I only wrote: Friday at noon, something left by Grandfather is waiting for you at Courtyard Inn.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shān hú. Often followed by 色 (sè, 'color') to name coral pink-orange.

examples.text: 暖金色和浅珊瑚色错开挂，整个石板院子就像晚霞一样！
examples.trans: Alternate warm gold and soft coral so the whole stone courtyard feels like sunset!

examples.text: 傍晚亮起灯时，珊瑚色纸灯笼把院子照得像抹了一层暖蜜。
examples.trans: When lit at dusk, the coral paper lanterns bathed the courtyard in a glow like warm honey.

examples.text: 按规则这球得重新来。
examples.trans: Under tournament rules, this ball has to be replayed.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: de. Links modifiers or owners to nouns (我的书 'my book', 安静的院子 'quiet courtyard').

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 纸本子？真的吗？
examples.trans: A paper notebook? Really?

盏.gloss: measure word for lamps and lanterns

meanings.en: measure word for lamps and lanterns
meanings.note: Pinyin: zhǎn. Counts lamps and lanterns (一盏台灯 'a desk lamp', 一盏灯笼 'a lantern').

examples.text: 楼下我的工具房里有一盏铜台灯。
examples.trans: Downstairs in my workshop there is a brass desk lamp.

examples.text: 门口挂着两盏红灯笼。
examples.trans: Two red lanterns hang by the entrance.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kàn. Covers looking at something, reading silently, or visiting someone; add 见/到 for 'catch sight of'.

examples.text: 我要看预订本子，可是找不到我的眼镜了！
examples.trans: I need to read the booking ledger, yet I cannot find my glasses!

examples.text: 老板，看一下桌子后面的镜子。
examples.trans: Boss, take a look in the mirror behind the desk.

examples.text: 我在飞机上已经看过了，基本能过。
examples.trans: I already read it on the plane; overall it passes.

examples.text: 我在飞机上已经看过了，基本能过。
examples.trans: I already read it on the plane; overall it passes.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shí bǎn. Combines 石 ('stone') + 板 ('slab/plank'); measure word: 块 (kuài).

examples.text: 如果你们有一天重开九号房，从老树往北数三块平石板！
examples.trans: If you ever reopen Room Nine, count three flat flagstones north from the old tree!

examples.text: 雨后的院子石板路干干净净，映着温暖的灯光。
examples.trans: After the rain, the courtyard flagstone path is spotless and reflects the warm lamplight.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhǒng. Read zhǒng as a measure word for kinds/types (这种, 那种); read zhòng as the verb 'plant/grow'.

examples.text: 老陈，这些香草是你自己种的吗？
examples.trans: Chen, did you grow these herbs yourself?

examples.text: 老房子连着旧回忆——那种争吵最伤人。
examples.trans: Old houses are tied to old memories—arguments like that cut deepest.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wén wěn. Reduplicated adverb describing steady hands or footing.

examples.text: 火苗亮了——稳稳的蓝火，正合适。
examples.trans: The flame is lit—steady blue fire, right as it should be.

examples.text: 她双手稳稳地端起盛满热茶的托盘。
examples.trans: With both hands she lifted the tray of hot tea steadily.

meanings.note: ordinal number

examples.text: 我是传媒学院的研究生，年级第一名。
examples.trans: I am a graduate student at the Media College, first in my year.

examples.text: 我是传媒学院的研究生，年级第一名。
examples.trans: I am a graduate student at the Media College, first in my year.

meanings.note: Ordinal numeral dìsān ('third').

examples.text: 接下来介绍第三季的全面改版计划。
examples.trans: Next we present the full overhaul plan for Season Three.

examples.text: 今晚的第三位竞演歌手即将登台演唱。
examples.trans: Tonight's third competing singer is about to take the stage.

meanings.note: Pinyin: suàn. Means 'calculate' or 'count as'.

examples.text: 明天早上八点，你们的第一杯小院咖啡算客栈请客！
examples.trans: And tomorrow morning at eight, your first courtyard coffees are on the house!

examples.text: 我算了一下，一共十五块钱。
examples.trans: I added it up—fifteen yuan in total.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhǐ. Measure word (量词): 张 (zhāng), e.g. 一张纸 ('a sheet of paper').

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 纸本子？真的吗？
examples.trans: A paper notebook? Really?

related.gloss: a sheet of paper (measure word 张)

examples.text: 傍晚时分，廊檐下挂起了一排温暖的红纸灯笼。
examples.trans: At dusk, a row of warm red paper lanterns was hung beneath the eaves.

examples.text: 小美亲手在纸灯笼上画了几枝淡雅的梅花。
examples.trans: Mei painted a few delicate plum branches on the paper lantern by hand.

examples.text: 把侯总的账结了。
examples.trans: Please settle the gentleman's tab on our way out.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 上个月你三天绕地球飞了一整圈，回来开电话会议，中文英文一个字没错过。
examples.trans: Last month you flew around the globe in three days and took a bilingual conference call without missing a single word!

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shéng. General noun for twisted cord or twine (细绳 'fine string/twine', 棉绳 'cotton string'); measure word: 根 (gēn) or 条 (tiáo).

examples.text: 用一根干净的厨房细绳把百里香和欧芹绑在一起，煮完汤方便捞出来。
examples.trans: Tie the thyme and parsley together with a clean piece of kitchen twine so they are easy to lift out after simmering.

examples.text: 木牌上面系着一根结实的麻绳，正好可以挂在大门口的铁钩上。
examples.trans: A sturdy hemp cord is tied to the top of the wooden sign so it hangs right on the iron hook outside the gate.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shéng zi. Measure word (量词): 根 (gēn) or 条 (tiáo).

examples.text: 包裹外面用一根粗糙的麻绳子紧紧缠着。
examples.trans: The parcel was tightly wrapped on the outside with a rough hemp rope.

examples.text: 小美找来一根红色的短绳子，把礼盒系上。
examples.trans: Mei found a short red string and tied up the gift box.

meanings.en: to stretch tight; keep a rope, cord, or muscle taut
meanings.note: Pinyin: bēng jǐn. Note level first tone bēng ('stretch tight'), vs third tone běng ('keep a straight face').

examples.text: 稳稳接住了！快告诉我打哪种结，才能一直绷紧到明晚？
examples.trans: Caught cleanly! Tell me what kind of knot keeps this cord tight until tomorrow evening!

examples.text: 绳子一绷紧，两排灯笼立刻顺着屋檐排成一条直线。
examples.trans: Once the cord was pulled taut, both rows of lanterns lined up straight along the eaves.

meanings.note: Pinyin: měi. Core stative adjective for visual, musical, or atmospheric beauty (美极了 'sounds/looks wonderful!').

examples.text: 在这间玻璃房里听您轻轻哼出旋律，真是美极了！
examples.trans: Hearing you hum the melody softly in this glass room is truly wonderful!

examples.text: 傍晚亮起灯笼的小院子特别美。
examples.trans: The little courtyard lit with lanterns at dusk is especially beautiful.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lǎo dì. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个老弟 ('a younger brother').

examples.text: 倔了三年……说实话，老弟，我也想你。
examples.trans: Three stubborn years... honestly, little brother, I missed you too.

examples.text: 老弟，你到底撞进了一家什么神奇客栈？
examples.trans: Little brother, what kind of magical inn did you stumble into?

meanings.note: Pinyin: néng. Expresses practical ability or whether circumstances allow something (能睡个好觉).

examples.text: 来成都的第一个晚上，怎么能难过呢！
examples.trans: On your very first evening in Chengdu, how could you sit around sad!

examples.text: 今晚我应该能睡个好觉了。
examples.trans: Tonight I should be able to sleep well after all.

meanings.en: color, shade, or hue (bound suffix in color names such as 珊瑚色 'coral')
meanings.note: Pinyin: sè. Standalone 'color' in everyday speech is 颜色 (yánsè).

examples.text: 暖金色和浅珊瑚色错开挂，整个石板院子就像晚霞一样！
examples.trans: Alternate warm gold and soft coral so the whole stone courtyard feels like sunset!

examples.text: 那张老地图的底色是温润的米色，看着就让人觉得安心。
examples.trans: The background color of that old map is a soft cream that feels soothing right away.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiē kǒu. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个街口 ('a street corner').

examples.text: 听……街口钟楼开始敲十二下了！
examples.trans: Listen... the clock tower at the end of the street is starting to strike twelve!

examples.text: 出了院门走到街口就能打到出租车。
examples.trans: Walk out the gate to the end of the lane and you can hail a cab.

meanings.en: want; need; will / be going to
meanings.note: Pinyin: yào. Direct verb for ordering/requesting ('want'), obligation ('need to'), or imminent future (要下雨了).

examples.text: 今天四号房的客人住一整个星期，一定要完美！
examples.trans: Today's guest in room four is staying a whole week; everything must be perfect!

examples.text: 我要看预订本子，可是找不到我的眼镜了！
examples.trans: I need to read the booking ledger, yet I cannot find my glasses!

meanings.note: yàobù — placed before a clause to tentatively propose an alternative or offer help
introduces an undesirable consequence if the preceding situation does not change (short for 要不然)

examples.text: 在那边，要不我带您过去？
examples.trans: Over there — how about I take you over?

examples.text: 快走吧，要不我们就要迟到了。
examples.trans: Let's hurry up, otherwise we are going to be late.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shì shi. Warm, low-pressure invitation to try something.

examples.text: 您看，这件软羊毛开衫是全新的，试试吧。
examples.trans: Look, this soft wool cardigan is brand-new; try it on.

examples.text: 这把备用钥匙能不能开，插进去试试就知道了。
examples.trans: Slip this spare key in and try it to see if it unlocks.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zǒu. Means 'walk' (走路, 直走) or 'leave / head off' (我先走了).

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 从这儿往里走。我帮您把蓝色行李箱提上去。
examples.trans: Walk inward from here. I will carry the blue suitcase up for you.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qǐ. Used for rising or lifting upward (抱起 'pick up in arms').

examples.text: 老陈，抱起那些纸箱，我们下楼吧！
examples.trans: Chen, pick up those cardboard boxes—down the stairs we go!

examples.text: 从那天起我们就再没说过话。上周我给他寄了一张明信片。
examples.trans: Since that day we have not spoken again. Last week I mailed him a postcard.

meanings.note: Classifier/noun lún ('round').

examples.text: 外面的合作谈判还需要再谈几轮吧。
examples.trans: Outside partnership talks will take a few more rounds.

examples.text: 经过三轮激烈比拼，冠军终于诞生了。
examples.trans: After three intense rounds, a champion emerged.

meanings.note: Pinyin: guò lái. Directional compound moving across toward the speaker.

examples.text: 你看，早餐忙乱和神秘电话你都挺过来了！
examples.trans: Look, you made it through both the breakfast rush and the mystery phone call!

examples.text: 因为星期一晚上我走过来时，看见我哥哥正走在这条街上！
examples.trans: Because when I walked here Monday night, I saw my older brother walking down this street!

examples.text: 这是什么套啊？
examples.trans: What kind of setup?

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dào. Appears in split verb-object phrases like 道个歉 ('offer an apology').

examples.text: 先生，上楼之前，我要诚恳跟您道个歉。
examples.trans: Sir, before going upstairs, I owe you an honest apology.

examples.text: 临走的时候，他特意来道谢。
examples.trans: Before leaving, he came specially to say thank you.

related.gloss: know (a fact or piece of information)

meanings.note: Pinyin: nà. Distal demonstrative before measure words (那个 'that one'); at clause start, means 'then / well then'.

examples.text: 那是什么铃声？有人按了两下！
examples.trans: What was that bell sound? Somebody rang twice!

examples.text: 那里没人。那是四号房的门铃。
examples.trans: Nobody is there. That is the buzzer from room four.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nà xiē. Plural of 那个 ('those').

examples.text: 老陈，抱起那些纸箱，我们下楼吧！
examples.trans: Chen, pick up those cardboard boxes—down the stairs we go!

examples.text: 抬头看夜空下那些金色灯笼——真宁静啊！
examples.trans: Look up at those golden lanterns against the night sky—how peaceful!

meanings.note: Pinyin: nàr. Spoken variant of 那里 ('there').

examples.text: 因为楼梯窄，而且周经理在那儿放了旧灯箱子。
examples.trans: Because the stairs are narrow, and Manager Zhou put old lamp boxes up there.

examples.text: 看车轮底下——铅笔写的你和我的名字还在那儿。
examples.trans: Look underneath the wheels—your name and mine in pencil are still right there.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nà biān. Points to a location or party on the other end.

examples.text: 宋老师，真对不起，那边还没有消息。
examples.trans: Teacher Song, I am truly sorry; they have no news over there yet.

examples.text: 冬天用掉最后一个了。只有桥那边的老五金店有这个尺寸。
examples.trans: Used the last one in winter. Only the old hardware shop past the bridge carries this size.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dōu. Summarizes everything BEFORE it and always stands directly before the verb/adjective (我们都喜欢).

examples.text: 谢谢！我们平时都直接叫名字吗？
examples.trans: Thank you! Do we usually just call each other by name here?

examples.text: 小美跟这条街上所有人说话都像老朋友。
examples.trans: Mei talks to everyone on this street like old friends.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jīn sè. Measure word (量词): 种 (zhǒng), e.g. 一种金色 ('a golden color').

examples.text: 最上面架子上金色包装那包。怎么了？
examples.trans: The gold-wrapped packet on the top shelf. Why?

examples.text: 门上方只画着一把金色钥匙。拿旧阀门给店员看。
examples.trans: Only a golden key painted above the door. Show the clerk the old valve.

meanings.note: Pinyin: pinyin. This is a noun used in conversational Mandarin. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个铁环 ('a 铁环').

examples.text: 我有一个铁环。
examples.trans: I have a 铁环.

examples.text: 这是一个非常好的铁环。
examples.trans: This is a very good 铁环.

meanings.note: Pinyin: cuò. Describes mistakes or serves as a result complement meaning 'wrongly' (拿错 'take the wrong one').

examples.text: 火车站有人拿错了我的蓝色行李箱！
examples.trans: Someone at the train station took my blue suitcase by mistake!

examples.text: 哎呀，怎么拿错了！我戴眼镜看看行李牌。
examples.trans: Dear me, what a mix-up! Let me put on my glasses and check the luggage tag.

meanings.note: Pinyin: mén kǒu. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 大门口 ('at the doorway').

examples.text: 等等——那星期一晚上门口台阶……第二个蓝箱子……
examples.trans: Wait—then Monday night on our front step... the second blue suitcase...

examples.text: 您为什么不直接去志鹏家门口把木头小火车交给他呢？
examples.trans: Why not go straight to Zhipeng's door and hand him the wooden train?

meanings.en: measure word for a passing spell, gust of wind, burst of applause, or shower
meanings.note: Pinyin: zhèn. Used in 一阵风 ('a gust of wind') and 一阵掌声 ('a burst of applause').

examples.text: 刚才从街口拱门吹过来的那阵凉风，你们感觉到了吗？
examples.trans: Did you feel that cool gust blowing through the street arch just now?

examples.text: 琴声刚落，树荫底下就响起了一阵热烈又长久的掌声。
examples.trans: As soon as the piano stopped, a warm, lingering burst of applause rose from under the shade tree.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yuàn zi. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个院子 ('a courtyard').

examples.text: 太好了。窗户朝街上还是朝院子？
examples.trans: Wonderful. Does the window face the street or the courtyard?

examples.text: 朝院子，就在老树上面，非常安静。
examples.trans: Toward the courtyard, right above the old tree; it is very quiet.

meanings.note: Pinyin: fēng. Measure word (量词): 阵, e.g. 一阵风 ('a gust of wind').

examples.text: 热汤？在冷雨中走过来之后，这听起来太棒了。
examples.trans: Hot soup? After that cold walk in the rain, that sounds wonderful.

examples.text: 春天下午的风又轻又暖。
examples.trans: The spring afternoon breeze is gentle and warm.

related.gloss: a gust of wind (measure word 阵)

meanings.note: Pinyin: gāo. Describes tall people, high ceilings, or high scores.

examples.text: 让我好好看看你，志豪！你长得比钢琴还高了！
examples.trans: Let me look at you properly, Zhihao! You grew taller than the piano!

examples.text: 我手在发抖——车上下来穿深灰色外套的高个子男人吗？
examples.trans: My hands are shaking—is a tall man in a dark grey coat stepping out?
